text_block_list.text:
With the second leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
the Nippon Derby, drawing near,
a piece of news suddenly came in—

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see?! Duramente-senpai's announcement.
It's incredible, she really feels like she's on a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san!
Is it true that you registered to run in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe during the Classic Year!!
It's a massive challenge, so please tell us how you're feeling heading into it!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"—At this stage,
all we have done is submit the entry."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, I have a duty to prove I am the strongest of my generation.
If I should accomplish that at the Nippon Derby—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The "World's Strongest"—meaning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
will come into view. This is a stepping stone for that.

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in the Classic Year, huh!
Still, if it's Duramente-senpai, she just might pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we're definitely gonna cheer during the Japan Derby, okay!?
I just HAVE to see Duramente-senpai
show everyone she's the strongest in the world!!

text_block_list.name: Lunch-Breaking Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally!! Ahh, I can't wait to see it—
Duramente-senpai's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I see... Duramente-san really is
serious about becoming the "strongest"...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I can see why people cheer for him...
Seeing that run in the Satsuki Sho,
even I found myself thinking the same thing—)
Ah, found you! So this is where you were, Cheval!
Hey, would you come with me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ――Yaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
――...*pant*... *pant*.
...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks, Cheval, for agreeing to train alongside me.
I'd like to do one more run, if that's alright with you?”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. I'm fine... I don't really have any plans anyway.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Really? That's a relief! I want to get a solid feel for the real deal, but I'm still not quite satisfied with it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...By "the main event," do you mean the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
Because to make the greatest contribution to the racing world, there is no better stage than the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...My mission as a Satono Umamusume
is to show a flawless victory in a G1 race
and bring excitement to the entire racing world."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Still, a grand stage demands preparation to match."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Fitting... preparation...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. Analyzing past races and figuring out your own path to victory from them. For example—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Unlike the tight turns of Nakayama,
the Derby's Tokyo Racecourse is a wide and spacious track.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
With a longer straight, there's less chaos in how the race unfolds.
In other words—it becomes a pure contest of raw ability.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"In contrast, my weapon is my closing kick on the final stretch.
I have to polish it without fail before the real deal
so that it'll work."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's why I wanted to race with you—someone whose legs hold out till the end, pushing me right to the wire.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: All of that... just for the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(So this is what it means to put everything into winning.
Never letting your eyes wander, not even for a second...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Miss Crown, you really aren't bothered, are you?
...About Miss Duramente's "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san?
Oh please, of course I care about her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: If I can't beat her, my dream won't come true. And yet, she's already dreaming of what lies beyond the Derby, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I was frustrated when I first heard it.
It was as good as being told
we weren't even on their radar. But you know—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Looking too far ahead and tripping over your own feet is an all-too-common tale. If you slack on your preparations, you're always the one left in tears—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So, I reconsidered and thought
it'd actually be nice if they let their guard down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Not in some distant future—
I will seize victory *now*.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Crown-san... never looks away.
Not from her dreams, and not from what she wants.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Duramente-san is the same.
The two of them know what they need to do for their dreams.
That's why they can give it their all—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(What do I really want to do...?
For the sake of my dream, what should I...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Crown-san.
I want to run more, too. So...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Right, shall we get going soon?
Let's both give it everything we've got—!

I came with Cheval Grand to watch
the second leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Nippon Derby.

The goal is to gauge the current strength of her peers
and determine the gap between them and Cheval Grand.
Or so it was supposed to be—
The result was a crushing victory for Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Duramente in the lead! Duramente in the lead!
There's no one left to challenge her... Crossing the line for glorious first place is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Duramente!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Behold the crystallization of pedigree, a miraculous run!! Strong, utterly strong, Duramente! A new era begins!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaa, you're amazing, Duramenteーー!
Keep this up and you'll be the "World's Strongest"ーーー!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Are these... cheers...? The ground is shaking—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the venue...
is looking at Duramente-san...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Miss Crown... your shoulders are trembling...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It's so frustrating...
Even after Crown-san planned out her strategy so meticulously,
she still couldn't reach them...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Besides... it's not just Crown-san—)

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniff*.
It's... over, the Derby...
I promised I'd win... no matter what... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I worked so hard for today... all this time...!
Damn it, damn it, damn it!
I could have done so much better!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She's... she's giving it her all too...
Yeah... that's right...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I knew it, the Derby really was special, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Because every single girl who couldn't win
looks so genuinely... heartbroken..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I put everything on the line, challenged with all I had, and that's why falling short hurts so much... but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I have to challenge them... Otherwise, I don't even have the right...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I thought... wow, you're amazing.
I really thought... you were incredible.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"The way you face your dreams head-on...
To me, it's just so dazzling..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I had to keep challenging myself too, after all...

Seeing her look as if she were enduring bitter frustration,
I felt that Cheval Grand's feelings toward racing had changed.

In the stands, where the excitement had yet to cool,
chants calling for Duramente continued to echoâ

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I shall perpetually demonstrate what it means to be the "strongest"...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Because that is my pride and my mission...
I declare—I will definitely win next time as well...!"
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Duramenteeeee!!!!
Win this and show us you're the strongest in the worlddd!!

And so, the Japanese Derby came to an end
amidst a whirlwind of excitement.

Just as declared beforehand,
Duramente made her immense power as the "strongest in the nation" fully known to all—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
……*sob*…… *sniff*.
Ugh…… aah……!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's... over...
The Derby... my...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ......Teio-san...
